strategic_differentiation: FIELDWISE differentiates itself by moving agricultural AI beyond retrospective predictive accuracy (R², RMSE, F1) toward operational decision value, evaluating models against temporal, geographic and operational transferability rather than accuracy alone. Its ambition is expressed as six explicit transitions (spectral proxy -> physiological target; hyperspectral discovery -> satellite scaling; static detection -> prospective prediction; internal validation -> temporal transferability; single-country modelling -> geographic transferability; research accuracy -> commercial-field decision value) and a four-step validation ladder (MATE scientific development -> MVCRI cross-country transferability -> AgroVIR farmer-field operational transferability -> DrR Web MVP research-to-operation delivery). It introduces Field Decision Value (FDV) as a final evaluation layer and provides a methodological bridge from high-information proximal hyperspectral observation to scalable Sentinel-2 prediction, positioned as a direct response to prior-evaluation criticisms on heterogeneous-data treatment, exploitation/IP substantiation, and late milestone placement.
